They replaced it with a four-cylinder. C63 used to mean 6.2 litres of
naturally aspirated V8; the current car is a 2.0 four with a hybrid system.
Same badge, half the cylinders.
The internals came out of the SLS. Forged pistons and rods from the
supercar, dropped into a C-Class, for 510 hp with no turbos anywhere.
About 800 built worldwide. Mercedes planned 650 and raised it when demand
came in higher than expected.
The rear seat was optional — you could delete it and save 55 pounds, in a
car with a back seat as standard equipment.
Wider track front and rear, flared arches, adjustable coilovers, 390mm
front discs and a mechanical limited-slip diff.

title: 510 Horsepower, No Turbos! 🔥

history.fact: Only 800 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Black Series models were built worldwide for the 2012 model year.

scenes.headline: AMG Powerhouse
scenes.narration: 510 horsepower from a naturally aspirated V8, all achieved without a turbocharger. That's the heart of the Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Black Series. Its aggressive front features large air intakes, enhancing aerodynamics.

scenes.headline: Rare Breed
scenes.narration: Only 800 were made in 2012, an exclusive performance icon. The striking red brake calipers behind dark alloy wheels highlight its track-ready design. Originally priced around $125,000, they've maintained value.

scenes.headline: Mechanical Edge
scenes.narration: The limited-slip differential helps this beast stick to the road. Four rectangular exhaust tips echo the performance-minded character.

scenes.headline: SLS DNA
scenes.narration: Inside lives AMG's M156 6.2L V8, sharing internals like forged pistons with the SLS AMG. It produces 457 lb-ft of torque.

scenes.headline: Focused Interior
scenes.narration: Inside, red stitching adds to the Black Series' unique flair. Deleting the optional rear seat saves weight, signaling its performance focus.

scenes.headline: Wider and Lower
scenes.narration: Fenders are flared to house a wider track and enhance handling. Adjustable coilovers allow for customized performance setups.

scenes.headline: What's the Future?
scenes.narration: Future C63 models have downsized to a 2.0L four-cylinder hybrid. Would you stick with V8 power or embrace new tech?

listing_facts.title: 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Coupe Black Series

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Black Series, finished in Diamond White with a black interior. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Mercedes-Benz's past; it also lists registrations in Nevada, Oregon, and Washington from new. This C63 AMG Black Series is 1 of 800 produced worldwide for the 2012 model year. The hardcore performance-focused Black Series boasts 59 horsepower and 14 lb-ft of torque over the standard C63 AMG, thanks to a revised ECU and forged pistons, connecting rods, and a crankshaft borrowed from the SLS AMG. It looks the part, too, with enlarged fenders, a wider track, and aggressive bodywork designed to scoop in more air and keep it planted firmly on the road. Factory equipment includes 19-inch 10-spoke forged alloy wheels, adjustable coilover suspension, a limited-slip differential, a panoramic sunroof, MB-Tex and Dinamica upholstery, heated front seats, carbon fiber interior trim, a Harman/Kardon sound system, a rear-view camera, and more as detailed below. Modifications reported by the seller include a resonator delete, tinted windows, and a Passport radar detector, plus paint protection film on the front end, A-pillars, and side skirts. Power comes from a hand-built "M156" 6.2-liter V8, rated at 510 horsepower and 457 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed AMG Speedshift multi-clutch automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential.
sections.Equipment: A build sheet is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: Black Series Package (increased engine output to 510 horsepower, limited-slip differential lock, carbon fiber trim, bi-xenon active headlights, intelligent highbeam control, headlamp washing system, rear-view camera, twin cupholders, voice control, Comand system with hard-drive navigation, collapsible spare tire, Keyless-Go) Black Series Seating Package (4-seat configuration) 19-inch 10-spoke forged alloy wheels Adjustable coilover suspension Panoramic sunroof MB-Tex and Dinamica upholstery Power-adjustable and heated front seats with memory function Harman/Kardon sound system Automatic climate control
